entries.name: John Broxton

expected.charges: Inciting to riot — Tallahassee lunch-counter sit-in
expected.sentence: Sixty days or a $300 fine at the March 17, 1960 trial. Chose jail; correspondence confirms continued confinement at Leon County Jail on April 28. Exact release remains unverified.

updates.sentence: Sixty days or a $300 fine at the March 17, 1960 trial. Entered Leon County Jail March 18 after choosing jail instead of paying the fine. Released May 5, 1960 for good behavior; the period is commonly described as 49 days inclusive (48 elapsed days).

entries.rationale: Priscilla first-person letter explicitly dates all eight admissions March18. WFSU individually identifies five who remained until May5, including John Broxton and William Larkins. Do not extend their release to the three who separately appealed; Carney letter predicts a release rather than documenting actual discharge.
